FEAT-5-S125.title: Allowlist Enforcement and Rejection Handling
FEAT-5-S125.description: Implement strict allowlist enforcement to reject any tool calls not explicitly registered, returning safe structured responses and preventing execution of unauthorized tools.

FEAT-5-S126.title: Structured Error Handling and Fallback Responses
FEAT-5-S126.description: Implement standardized error handling for schema validation failures, tool execution exceptions, and malformed tool_use blocks, ensuring safe fallback responses are returned to the chat loop.

FEAT-5-S127.title: Tool Routing Observability and Debug Logging
FEAT-5-S127.description: Integrate debug logging for tool routing events including tool selection, validation outcomes, execution timing, and errors, aligned with existing debug_logger infrastructure.
